itens.titulo: Crédito com garantia pública deveria seguir em qualquer governo, diz CEO do Bradesco
itens.descricao: Crédito com garantia pública deveria seguir em qualquer governo, diz CEO do Bradesco Bloomberg Línea Brasil
trechos: Para Noronha, os fundos formam “um dos melhores programas governamentais que a gente já viu em todos os tempos”, por oferecer às empresas prazos mais longos, juros menores e carência.
“Independentemente do governo, eu, se estivesse sentado [na cadeira de quem decide], manteria essas linhas”, disse em teleconferência com analistas.
“Esse vento, se bater, não bate só aqui.
Vai bater no mercado, de uma forma geral”, afirmou.
As linhas já estão entre as cinco maiores carteiras do Bradesco e crescem 31% em um ano, segundo os executivos.
Morgan, elas responderam por 0,14 ponto percentual da alta dos atrasos acima de 90 dias, que foram de 4,3% para 4,6% da carteira no trimestre.
A cartilha econômica de Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) propõe limitar “o crédito subsidiado com recursos do Tesouro” e não menciona os fundos garantidores.
Em debate na Band, o candidato propôs que o governo compre dívidas bancárias com desconto e dê carência de até 12 meses a empresas.

itens.titulo: AMD Has a High Floor, High Volatility Trajectory Through the End of 2026
itens.descricao: AMD Has a High Floor, High Volatility Trajectory Through the End of 2026 Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read - AMD's Data Center revenue doubled 107% to $6.72 billion in Q2, with Q3 guidance of ~$13 billion implying roughly 41% growth.
- OpenAI, Meta, and Anthropic have signed commitments totaling up to 14 GW of MI450 GPUs, with management expecting Data Center revenue to more than double in 2027.
- At 141x trailing earnings with a beta of 2.454, AMD dropped 18.57% in one month while the S&P 500 slid just 1%.
- Read More: Learn 7 ways to generate income with a $1,000,000+ portfolio (sponsor) AMD (NASDAQ:AMD) trades at $507.93.
The business has a high fundamental floor, but the stock is prone to sharp swings through the end of 2026.
Shares fell 8.1% in a single session as oil prices rose and questions about AI spending returned, so the current price puts investor conviction to a real test.
Data Center now generates 58% of revenue.
The stock is up 137.17% year to date but has dropped 18.57% over the past month.

itens.titulo: Bitcoin’s midterm bottom pattern faces a test as QQQ shows mixed returns
itens.descricao: Bitcoin’s midterm bottom pattern faces a test as QQQ shows mixed returns CoinDesk
trechos: - Bitcoin reached major bear-market lows shortly after the 2014, 2018 and 2022 midterm elections, but this year’s low came 125 days before Election Day.
- Bitcoin recovered about 40% from its July 1 low of $57,850 to roughly $81,455 on Oct.
22, despite falling about 6% over the past 30 days.
Bitcoin bottomed in January 2015, December 2018 and November 2022, shortly after the preceding midterms.
Those lows arrived approximately 71, 38 and 13 days after election day, respectively.
Bitcoin touched $57,850 on July 1, some 125 days before the Nov.
22, the price had recovered to around $81,455, roughly 40% above that low.
Bitcoin fell approximately 29% in the six months before the 2018 midterms and 37% before the 2022 vote.
